# Zik4U

> The social network built on what you actually listen to.

Zik4U is a music social network that builds a listening identity from what people really play. On Android, with the notification access the user grants, the app reads the "now playing" notifications of a fixed list of music apps (Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, Tidal and others) and keeps track title, artist, album, duration, time played and source app. Zik4U connects to no streaming account and uses no streaming service API.

## Core concepts

- **Listening identity**: A user's musical profile derived from their actual listening across music apps, not self-reported preferences.
- **Capture**: Reading the playback notifications of music apps on the user's phone. Metadata only: no audio, no streaming account, no other notification.
- **Music compatibility**: A similarity score computed from shared listening between two users. Powers social discovery.
- **Creator system**: Creators offer subscriptions; fans subscribe to see what they actually listen to. Creators receive 80% of the net amount Zik4U receives after the app store commission.
- **Pulse**: Live listening rooms where members share reactions in real time.

## Privacy model

- Zik4U is not a music player: every play button opens the track in the user's own music app.
- An emotional music profile (moods, listener archetype) is on by default and can be turned off at any time, which deletes it. Moods are never shared.
- Music research is opt-in, adults only: partners receive only weekly trends computed over 100 people or more, with noise added. Never individuals.
- Visitors without an account see only a name, avatar and bio.
- Users can download or delete all their data at any time.
- Full details: https://zik4u.com/legal/privacy

## App

- Android: Google Play (com.zik4u.app), launching soon
- iOS: App Store, launching later
- Web: https://zik4u.com

## Technical

- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Realtime + Edge Functions), hosted in the United States
- Mobile: React Native + Expo SDK 53
- Web: Next.js (App Router)
- Payments: in-app purchases through the App Store and Google Play (RevenueCat); no payment on the website
